about_short_description.short_description: Cascade Space offers tools and ground station services for designing and analyzing communication systems in deep space missions.

product.name: Cascade Portal
product.description: An online portal providing spacecraft design software, test plans, and link budget tools to support mission design and operation.

product.name: RF Designer
product.description: A software tool to design spacecraft RF systems using commercially available components and model link margin performance.

product.name: Test Wizard
product.description: A tool to create spacecraft test plans from proven templates to validate communication system designs.

product.name: Cascade Network
product.description: A ground station network providing communication coverage for missions beyond low Earth orbit, including lunar and deep space operations.
